images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a wide photographic source plate for a privacy-relay demo video. Create ONE continuous horizontal 3:2 street photograph, ideally 1536x1024 or larger, never a montage. It is a completely fictional town, not any recognizable real location. Documentary realism, natural neutral overcast daylight, subtle weathered material textures, eye-level camera 1.6 m above pavement, straight verticals, horizon about 55% from top, pavement in bottom third. Match a believable street-level 35 mm lens, no dramatic blur or artificial depth of field. Keep both outer 10% strips mostly neutral masonry, tree foliage or fence, with no text there, to permit a spatial panorama join. All readable words must be EXACTLY those specified below; no other text. No real business names, trademarks, manufacturer badges, logos, watermarks, visible people, music, interface elements or captions. The scene must feel like an actual photograph, not a rendering. Text must be physically part of objects with perspective, material texture, weathering and consistent light; NEVER float a flat rectangle or caption over the image. Important text belongs in the middle 60% of image height, at several scales and distances; leave generous environment around it for a slow camera pan. There should be no added rectangular graphic labels. Scene: A small street of three modest fictional shopfronts at a slight oblique angle. On the nearest shop, the words "TAVREN BINDERY" are carved into a thick wooden hanging sign attached with two real metal brackets, with its shadow visible on plaster. A second shop has "MORROWFEN REPAIRS" painted along a faded fabric awning, naturally foreshortened. A little door number "38" is affixed to the door jamb. The hanging board must actually contain the lettering, not remain blank. Include a parked plain bicycle partly occluding a lower shop window, a planter and natural reflections. Several lettering sizes, some storefront detail partially behind foliage. No product labels, stickers or extra words. No modern corporate architecture.
